title: 第16章 即使尸山血海，也是名门正派！
novel_title: 宗门收徒，我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
楚星尘带着宁芊芊一路疯狂土遁。

    此刻也不考虑节省自身灵力，只想尽快赶回破庙之中。

    不过毕竟带着是毫无修为的凡人，速度必然会被拖累。

    尤其是宁芊芊对于金丹级别的土遁之术抵抗力实在不强，每隔一段时间必需停下来休息一会。

    毕竟她本身的体质也没多好，营养不良，骨瘦如柴。

    经过一日奔波，距离破庙也只有一次土遁距离。

    此刻的宁芊芊正倚靠在一棵大树下啃着饼子。

    楚星尘则是在一旁闭目警惕，神识外放。

    宁芊芊将手中的大饼全部吃完后，浅浅喝了两口水。

    之前路上休息的时候，宁芊芊也问了许多问题。

    问了楚星尘打算去哪，去做什么，找谁。

    楚星尘倒是蛮有耐心地回答，也没什么隐瞒。

    也跟宁芊芊交代去清楚是去找自己的徒弟，目的是跟自己的徒弟商量好计划。

    路上多的时候，宁芊芊也会询问一些修仙界的事情，虽然听起来还是一知半解，但她也会依靠自己的理解去想象。

    宁芊芊看着闭目的楚星尘，将嘴边的饼屑全部塞进嘴里后，语气有些不可置信的问道：

    “大仙，清风宗在你们的世界真的是名门正派？”

    “在附近的宗门名声来说是这样的。”楚星尘没有睁眼，“他们也会接下官府的委托降妖除魔，而且他们做坏事也将消息隐蔽的很好，起码之前我也是没听说过的。”

    这些道理宁芊芊倒也懂得，毕竟她只是见识少，不是人傻。

    不过听到这种回答，又想起阿爹走的时候的背影。

    她依旧有些萎靡，抬起眼眸：“那大仙你的宗门呢？也会做这种事吗？”

    闻言楚星尘忍不住抬起眼来，没好气道：“要做这种事，就不会心软把你带走了。”

    一路上面对宁芊芊十万个为什么，楚星尘还是颇有耐心的。

    反正等顺手把她爹救出来之后，自己估计也再也见不到这个丫头了。

    听到回答的宁芊芊则是十分认可的点了点头，毕竟事实也是如此。
content_en:
Chu Xingchen took Ning Qianqian all the way to escape wildly.

At this moment, he didn't think about saving his spiritual power, he just wanted to rush back to the ruined temple as soon as possible.

But after all, he is a mortal with no cultivation, so his speed will inevitably be slowed down.

In particular, Ning Qianqian is not very resistant to the golden elixir-level earth escape technique, so she must stop and rest every once in a while.

After all, her own physical condition was not very good, she was malnourished and skinny.

After a day of running around, we were only one Earth Escape away from the ruined temple.

At this moment, Ning Qianqian was leaning under a big tree and eating pancakes.

Chu Xingchen, on the other hand, closed his eyes and was alert, letting his consciousness go out.

After Ning Qianqian finished eating all the pie in her hand, she took a few sips of water.

While resting on the road, Ning Qianqian also asked many questions.

He asked Chu Xingchen where he planned to go, what he was going to do, and who he was looking for.

Chu Xingchen answered patiently and had nothing to hide.

He also told Ning Qianqian that he was looking for his apprentice in order to discuss a plan with his apprentice.

When she is on the road a lot, Ning Qianqian will also ask about some things about the world of immortality. Although she still sounds half-informed, she will also rely on her own understanding to imagine.

Ning Qianqian looked at Chu Xingchen with his eyes closed, stuffed all the cake crumbs in his mouth, and asked in a somewhat disbelieving tone:

"Great Immortal, is the Qingfeng Sect really a famous and upright sect in your world?"

"The reputation of the nearby sects is like this." Chu Xingchen did not open his eyes. "They will also accept commissions from the government to slay demons and eliminate demons, and they also hide the news very well when they do bad things. At least I have never heard of them before."

Ning Qianqian understands these truths. After all, she just has little knowledge and is not stupid.

But after hearing this answer, I remembered my father's back when he left.

She was still a little sluggish and raised her eyes: "What about your sect, Great Immortal? Will it do such a thing?"

Hearing this, Chu Xingchen couldn't help but raise his eyes and said angrily: "If I want to do something like this, I won't be soft-hearted and take you away."

Facing Ning Qianqian's hundreds of thousands of reasons along the way, Chu Xingchen was still quite patient.

Anyway, after successfully rescuing her father, I probably would never see this girl again.

After hearing the answer, Ning Qianqian nodded in agreement. After all, this was the truth.
